question: Which of the following is the Fundamental Law of any country which sets out the framework and the principal functions of various organs of the government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Constitution**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Constitution** is the fundamental law of any country.
 
• It sets out the framework and the principal functions of various organs of the government.
 
• The Constitution provides the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions.
